main_measure.name: mean unusual 72-bar move per long case (return minus coin's normal 72-bar drift)

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move with rise30_rec above its median minus below

decided_by: The mean unusual move has a t of at least 2 and the supporting check is above 0.
reading: Cases are the first long bet per 72-bar grid cell of each window (cells from the window's first row, cases whose 72-bar return leaves the window dropped), the rise30_rec median is pooled over all cases with cases at the median left out, and fewer than 30 cases is reported as not observable.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
